title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhaustion
content: Cause: Idle connections or traffic spike exceeding max_connections. Fix: Run SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity; terminate idle sessions using pg_terminate_backend(), and verify PgBouncer pool limits.

title: JWT Brute-Force & Credential Stuffing Spike
content: Cause: Repeated 401 Unauthorized POST /auth/login attempts from single IP subnet. Fix: Enable Redis rate-limiting (max 5 req/min), block offending CIDR block in WAF, and rotate compromised session tokens.

title: Docker Container OOMKilled (Exit Code 137)
content: Cause: Memory leak or unoptimized batch query exceeding container RAM limit. Fix: Inspect docker stats, analyze heap dump, increase container memory limit in compose/k8s manifest, and restart service.
